tools.name: usdc_token_info
tools.description: Native USDC contract address, decimals, EIP-712 domain (name, version, domainSeparator) and EIP-3009 support for a chain, verified onchain. Pass chain as a chain id (8453) or slug (base). Omit chain to list all chains.

tools.name: rpc_getlogs_limits
tools.description: Measured eth_getLogs block-range limits, latency, archive support and error messages for free public RPC endpoints. Pass chain (id or slug) to filter.

tools.name: paid_x402_tools
tools.description: Lists the pay-per-call x402 HTTP endpoints on this site (USDC on Base): Safe Read (webpage to clean text with a prompt injection scan), x402 Preflight (check an x402 endpoint before paying), and the x402 Seller Field Guide.
